m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Waaaaaugh! You stink of dead tree stump. What is it now? Problems with your Goat Weaver Pen, huh?
What kind of bait did you use? No bait? Well there's your problem! Goat Weavers are shy creatures. They like to be wooed.
Fill the Pen with some Sea Weed from Crescent Beach. Goat Weavers love Sea Weed. Get to it!
So now, we just still-wait? This makes no wise-sense. Why would the Goat Weaver just hop into... this?
Spellbinder, maybe your bug-friend forgot to give you all of the true-yarns. You better ask him soft-soft again.
Now the Pen looks like it will catch-and-hold a hug-em squeeze-em Goat Weaver! Thanks for your work-sweat, Spellbinder.
It shouldn't be long until a hungry Goat Weaver hops into the Pen for some Comestibles. I better keep my eyes razored to trap him!
<ITALICS>You recall that K'Torr J'rrol has always been a safely oblivious source of information. You tell Joshua you'll ask him. </ITALICS>
Thanks to your heroic-do-goodering, we should be safe from the bite-mandibles and spoken-word of those underground-beasts-of-awful-strength.
Still, I would feel on-higher-ground if we could smith-up our camp with true-hard materials.
The Umbra Goat Weaver Silk is true-hard, but we can never pilfer more than a tiny hop.
We need a hug-em squeeze-em Goat Weaver. Do you grok any yarns of how to get one?
Please ask your... bug-friend K'torr J'rrol for yarns on how to catch-and-hold a Goatweaver.
